title: Modules and Paths
summary: Modules group items into namespaces, establish privacy boundaries, and structure code.
lecture: Modules group related functions, structs, and sub-modules under a single namespace.
Items inside a module are private by default to everything outside that module.
Use `crate::`, `super::`, and `self::` to navigate paths across module hierarchies.
